items.title: Global refinery runs fell 6% in spring after the Hormuz disruption and are still 5% below last year
items.tldr: The US Energy Information Administration says world crude oil input to refineries fell 4.8 million barrels per day in the second quarter of 2026 and had recovered only partly by the third quarter.

items.title: 2026 is on course to tie or beat 2024 as the warmest year, with a record El Niño building, Carbon Brief finds
items.tldr: Carbon Brief's quarterly analysis of six temperature datasets says 2026 will be the warmest or second-warmest year, and projects that a record El Niño will make 2027 the warmest year with 96% probability.

items.title: Adaptation finance for developing countries has stalled, UN report says, ahead of COP31
items.tldr: UNEP's 2026 Adaptation Gap Report finds international adaptation finance at most $32 billion in 2024, flat or falling since 2022, against a need of $305 billion a year by 2035, according to the Guardian.
items.byline: UNEP Adaptation Gap Report page, The Guardian

items.title: Zero emissions commitment depends on warming level
items.tldr: In UK Earth System Model simulations, temperature stays roughly flat after emissions stop if warming is 2 degrees or less, but keeps rising by 0.4-0.6 degrees over 150 years from 3 to 5 degrees.
items.byline: Laura Gibbs, Chris D. Jones, Colin Jones et al. · Nature Climate Change (affiliations not shown on the page read)
